newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close lower amid firm sterling.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close lower amid firm sterling.

text.p: LIFFE wheat futures ended lower on Monday, helped down by sterling's strength against other European currencies, traders said.
The shipper buying, which had kept the market buoyant in trading up to Friday, had largely evaporated, they said.
Active March last traded at 98.15 stg per tonne, 0.60 stg lower, on volume of 111 lots.
The biggest fall was for July, down 0.70 stg to 101.15 stg per tonne on 45 lots.
Barley followed the same move down in volume of just 20 lots overall. November, most active with 15 lots done, last traded 0.50 stg lower at 95.00 stg per tonne.
All the remaining trade, five lots, was on September, which also last traded 0.50 stg down, at 93.00 stg.
